argv: Exact historical source-backed D7 citation regression is independently accepted at this current composition. The actual class passes all 7 checks, including three phantom citation forms through production extraction/resolution. Journalled removal of the real manuscript headline gives intended RED and exact restored GREEN with bytes/fullmode/nsmtime and empty journal. D7_REGRESSION_REUSE_R1_READBACK.json and its archive preserve original finding, actual baseline/current controls, both independent reviews and limits. This closes only the focused test-regression defect; numeric150>117, cached-extraction freshness/native, physical D7/simulability, full G11/main/publication/human acceptance remain open.
